  ESTIMATE, not a measurement: what sending no_tools, notification, suggestion to one shared cheaper tier would have cost, over the tokens actually recorded.
  A call is warm only when the previous routable side call of the same conversation was inside the cache TTL; nothing else would keep that tier warm. Cold calls pay a full write of the whole prompt.
  A call whose prompt exceeds the target tier's context ceiling cannot be routed there at all and is counted under "over ceiling", never in the saving.

  candidates (net = conversations ever pinned below the requested tier carved out, removing the warm-cache interaction), at both cache TTLs since the log does not record one for these calls, or records both:
